facts_raw.Primary Value: Capital + Customer / Pilot Access + Network / Mentorship
facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Focus: Fintech / mobility / health / enterprise / energy / more
facts_raw.Capital Type: No Standard Guaranteed Capital; optional separate investment
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Corporate pilots, PoCs, partner/investor network; specific tracks may offer credits/grants or separate investment
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Program-specific; Plug and Play Ventures investment is separate/optional
facts_raw.Non-dilutive: Program participation generally equity-free in published PnP programs
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: No universal equity requirement for accelerator participation; any separate investment is negotiated deal-by-deal
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Track-specific by vertical/corporate/government partner; no single universal numeric eligibility bar.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 Silicon Valley + global hubs 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Verification: Official/current program ecosystem; exact terms must use child track
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；Fintech；Climate / Energy；B2B / Enterprise SaaS；阶段以 Early–growth 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: this umbrella row should not be directly recommended. Recommend specific PnP child programs only.
